title: [BUG] [Payment]
body:
Dear Anthropic Support,
I am writing to you today regarding a billing issue with my Claude Pro subscription. I recently signed up for the service, but it appears my payment was processed twice for the same account.
I would like to request a refund for the duplicate charge. My account is associated with the email address [ahmet.ozkan498@gmail.com](mailto:ahmet.ozkan498@gmail.com)
Thank you for your time and assistance.
Sincerely,
Ahmet Özkan
author: Ahmetzkan
